A lease expires at an absolute simulated\n// time; renewal extends it only if the presented token still identifies the\n// current holder. All mutating requests are idempotent under a client supplied\n// ReqID, so a retried (duplicated) request after a lost reply cannot mint a\n// second fence or corrupt the lease.\npackage lock\n\nimport (\n\t\"sync\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// lease is the per-resource lock state.\ntype lease struct {\n\tfence    int64  // current fence token; 0 means free\n\tholder   string // node id of current holder\n\texpiry   int64  // absolute simulated time\n\tttl      int64  // last requested ttl\n\treleased bool\n}\n\ntype cacheKey struct{ method, reqID string }\n\n// Service is the lock server, one simulated node (\"lockserver\").\ntype Service struct {\n\tid     string\n\tmu     sync.Mutex // deterministic single goroutine, kept for documentation\n\tleases map[string]*lease\n\tfences map[string]int64 // highest token ever handed out per resource\n\tcache  map[cacheKey]proto.LockResp\n}\n\n// New creates a lock service node.\nfunc New(id string) *Service {\n\treturn &Service{id: id, leases: map[string]*lease{}, fences: map[string]int64{}, cache: map[cacheKey]proto.LockResp{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (s *Service) NodeID() string { return s.id }\n\n// expiredLocked reports whether l is free at time now, performing lazy expiry.\nfunc (s *Service) expiredLocked(l *lease, now int64) bool {\n\tif l.fence == 0 {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif now >= l.expiry {\n\t\tl.fence, l.holder, l.released = 0, \"\", false\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\nfunc (s *Service) reply(env *sim.Env, to string, resp proto.LockResp, method string) {\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: s.id, To: to, Method: method, Body: proto.Encode(resp)})\n}\n\n// Handle dispatches lock RPCs.\nfunc (s *Service) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind != \"message\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tmsg := ev.Msg\n\tnow := env.Now()\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tswitch msg.Method {\n\tcase proto.Acquire:\n\t\tvar req proto.AcquireReq\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &req); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tkey := cacheKey{proto.Acquire, req.ReqID}\n\t\tif cached, ok := s.cache[key]; ok {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.served_from_cache\", map[string]any{\"req_id\": req.ReqID, \"method\": proto.Acquire})\n\t\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, cached, proto.AcquireResp)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tl := s.leases[req.Resource]\n\t\tif l == nil {\n\t\t\tl = &lease{}\n\t\t\ts.leases[req.Resource] = l\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Re-entrant: same holder while still owned -> return same token.\n\t\tif l.fence != 0 && l.holder == msg.From && !s.expiredLocked(l, now) {\n\t\t\tresp := proto.LockResp{OK: true, Fence: l.fence, Resource: req.Resource, Expiry: l.expiry, ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t\ts.cache[key] = resp\n\t\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, resp, proto.AcquireResp)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !s.expiredLocked(l, now) {\n\t\t\tresp := proto.LockResp{OK: false, Resource: req.Resource, Reason: \"conflict\", Expiry: l.expiry, ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t\ts.cache[key] = resp\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.acquire_rejected\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\"resource\": req.Resource, \"holder\": l.holder, \"fence\": l.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, resp, proto.AcquireResp)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.fences[req.Resource]++\n\t\ttoken := s.fences[req.Resource]\n\t\tl.fence, l.holder, l.ttl, l.released = token, msg.From, req.TTL, false\n\t\tl.expiry = now + req.TTL\n\t\tresp := proto.LockResp{OK: true, Fence: token, Resource: req.Resource, Expiry: l.expiry, ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\ts.cache[key] = resp\n\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": req.Resource, \"fence\": token, \"holder\": msg.From, \"expiry\": l.expiry,\n\t\t})\n\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, resp, proto.AcquireResp)\n\n\tcase proto.Renew:\n\t\tvar req proto.RenewReq\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &req); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tkey := cacheKey{proto.Renew, req.ReqID}\n\t\tif cached, ok := s.cache[key]; ok {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.served_from_cache\", map[string]any{\"req_id\": req.ReqID, \"method\": proto.Renew})\n\t\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, cached, proto.RenewResp)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tl := s.leases[req.Resource]\n\t\tvar resp proto.LockResp\n\t\tswitch {\n\t\tcase l == nil || s.expiredLocked(l, now):\n\t\t\tresp = proto.LockResp{OK: false, Resource: req.Resource, Fence: req.Fence, Reason: \"lease_expired\", ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.renew_rejected\", map[string]any{\"resource\": req.Resource, \"fence\": req.Fence, \"reason\": \"lease_expired\"})\n\t\tcase l.fence != req.Fence || l.holder != msg.From:\n\t\t\tresp = proto.LockResp{OK: false, Resource: req.Resource, Fence: req.Fence, Reason: \"fencing_token_stale\", ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.renew_rejected\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\"resource\": req.Resource, \"fence\": req.Fence, \"current_fence\": l.fence, \"reason\": \"fencing_token_stale\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tl.expiry = now + req.TTL\n\t\t\tl.ttl = req.TTL\n\t\t\tresp = proto.LockResp{OK: true, Fence: l.fence, Resource: req.Resource, Expiry: l.expiry, ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.renewed\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\"resource\": req.Resource, \"fence\": l.fence, \"expiry\": l.expiry,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.cache[key] = resp\n\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, resp, proto.RenewResp)\n\n\tcase proto.Release:\n\t\tvar req proto.ReleaseReq\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &req); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tkey := cacheKey{proto.Release, req.ReqID}\n\t\tif cached, ok := s.cache[key]; ok {\n\t\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, cached, proto.ReleaseResp)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tl := s.leases[req.Resource]\n\t\tresp := proto.LockResp{OK: false, Resource: req.Resource, Fence: req.Fence, Reason: \"not_holder\", ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\tif l != nil && l.fence == req.Fence && l.holder == msg.From {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"lock.released\", map[string]any{\"resource\": req.Resource, \"fence\": req.Fence})\n\t\t\tl.fence, l.holder, l.released = 0, \"\", true\n\t\t\tresp = proto.LockResp{OK: true, Fence: req.Fence, Resource: req.Resource, Expiry: now, ReqID: req.ReqID}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.cache[key] = resp\n\t\ts.reply(env, msg.From, resp, proto.ReleaseResp)\n\t}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8d13a60ab2baf0070d644632","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":777,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":45880,"output_tokens":2110,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_lwln7pszf57dtlvmrix315qf":{"content":"// Package lock implements the fencing lease lock service.\n//\n// Every successful acquisition of a resource produces a strictly increasing\n// fence token for that resource. That single rule is what makes a paused/stale lock\n// holder harmless even if the client believes it still owns the lock.\n//\n// Fenced controls the policy. Fenced=true (the real system): token must be\n// strictly greater than the high-water mark; duplicate writes with the same\n// token are also rejected, so each successful write appears exactly once and\n// in token order. Fenced=false models the naive baseline used by the\n// no-fencing demo, where any non-zero token is accepted.\npackage resource\n\nimport (\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Entry is one accepted write.\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTime  int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tFence int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tNode  string `json:\"node\"`\n\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// Resource is a simulated resource node.\ntype Resource struct {\n\tid      string\n\tfenced  bool\n\thigh    int64\n\tlog     []Entry\n\tseenReq map[string]bool\n}\n\n// New creates a resource. fenced toggles fence-token enforcement.\nfunc New(id string, fenced bool) *Resource {\n\treturn &Resource{id: id, fenced: fenced, seenReq: map[string]bool{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (r *Resource) NodeID() string { return r.id }\n\n// HighWater returns the largest accepted fence token.\nfunc {"parentUuid":"28fccdd0-a50b-4818-a71f-ee5a03d71793","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ej7icric39owg8x9ykqlmmei","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b/internal/node/node.go","content":"// Package node is the client side: it acquires leases, renews them on a\n// heartbeat, tracks a conservative local deadline, and writes to the\n// protected resource.\n//\n// The interesting failure mode lives here: after a node is paused longer than\n// its lease (see sim.Engine.Pause), the lock service has handed the resource\n// to someone else, but on resume the frozen node still holds its old fence\n// token in memory and its work loop keeps going. Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      string\n\tresAddr func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds   map[string]*hold\n\treqSeq  int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(compTimer) && ev.Name[:len(compTimer)] == compTimer:\n\t\t// Compete loop self-ticks carry their config in Data and use the\n\t\t// CmdCompete marker; retained under a private name as well.\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) localExpiry(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\tn.markLost(env, res, \"local_deadline_reached\")\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) submit(env *sim.Env, res, value string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_skipped\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"node_continues_after_loss\",\n\t\t})\n\t} else {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value})\n\t}\n\treq := proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(compTimer) && ev.Name[:len(compTimer)] == compTimer:\n\t\t// Compete loop self-ticks carry their config in Data and use the\n\t\t// CmdCompete marker; retained under a private name as well.\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) localExpiry(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\tn.markLost(env, res, \"local_deadline_reached\")\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) submit(env *sim.Env, res, value string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_skipped\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"node_continues_after_loss\",\n\t\t})\n\t} else {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value})\n\t}\n\treq := proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + 1), \"count\": int64(count),\n\t\t\t\"interval\": interval, \"prefix\": prefix,\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.After(interval, CmdCompete, next)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleMessage(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tmsg := ev.Msg\n\tswitch msg.Method {\n\tcase proto.AcquireResp:\n\t\tvar r proto.LockResp\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &r); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !r.OK {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_denied\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"reason\": r.Reason})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif existing := n.holds[r.Resource]; existing != nil && existing.fence == r.Fence && !existing.lost {\n\t\t\treturn // duplicate grant delivery\n\t\t}\n\t\th := &hold{fence: r.Fence, ttl: r.Expiry - env.Now(), expiry: r.Expiry}\n\t\tif h.ttl <= 0 {\n\t\t\th.ttl = existingTTL(r.Resource, n.holds)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.holds[r.Resource] = h\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.acquired\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"expiry\": r.Expiry})\n\t\tn.startLeaseTimers(env, r.Resource, h)\n\n\tcase proto.RenewResp:\n\t\tvar r proto.LockResp\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &r); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\th := n.holds[r.Resource]\n\t\tif h == nil {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_result_ignored\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"reason\": \"no_hold\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.OK Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"node_continues_after_loss\",\n\t\t})\n\t} else {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value})\n\t}\n\treq := proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + 1), \"count\": int64(count),\n\t\t\t\"interval\": interval, \"prefix\": prefix,\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.After(interval, CmdCompete, next)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleMessage(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) existing.fence == r.Fence && !existing.lost {\n\t\t\treturn // duplicate grant delivery\n\t\t}\n\t\th := &hold{fence: r.Fence, ttl: r.Expiry - env.Now(), expiry: r.Expiry}\n\t\tif h.ttl <= 0 Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\tn.pending[res] = ttl\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + 1), \"count\": int64(count),\n\t\t\t\"interval\": interval, \"prefix\": prefix,\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.After(interval, CmdCompete, next)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleMessage(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) existing.fence == r.Fence && !existing.lost {\n\t\t\treturn // duplicate grant delivery\n\t\t}\n\t\th := &hold{fence: r.Fence, ttl: r.Expiry - env.Now(), expiry: r.Expiry}\n\t\tif h.ttl <= 0 Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\tn.pending[res] = ttl\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) localExpiry(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\tn.markLost(env, res, \"local_deadline_reached\")\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) submit(env *sim.Env, res, value string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_skipped\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"node_continues_after_loss\",\n\t\t})\n\t} else {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value})\n\t}\n\treq := proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + 1), \"count\": int64(count),\n\t\t\t\"interval\": interval, \"prefix\": prefix,\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.After(interval, CmdCompete, next)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleMessage(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) existing.fence == r.Fence && !existing.lost {\n\t\t\treturn // duplicate grant delivery\n\t\t}\n\t\tttl := n.pending[r.Resource]\n\t\tdelete(n.pending, r.Resource)\n\t\th := &hold{fence: r.Fence, ttl: Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\tn.pending[res] = ttl\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n\tcompTimer   = \"compete:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; ok {\n\t\tif s, ok := v.(string); ok {\n\t\t\treturn s\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc dataInt64(d map[string]any, k string) int64 {\n\tswitch v := d[k].(type) {\n\tcase int64:\n\t\treturn v\n\tcase int:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase float64:\n\t\treturn int64(v)\n\tcase string:\n\t\tx, _ := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64)\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// Handle processes commands, timers and RPC responses.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tn.handleTimer(env, ev)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tn.handleMessage(env, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleTimer(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\td := ev.Data\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdAcquire:\n\t\tn.acquire(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataInt64(d, \"ttl\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdSubmit:\n\t\tn.submit(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"), dataString(d, \"value\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdRelease:\n\t\tn.release(env, dataString(d, \"resource\"))\n\tcase ev.Name == CmdCompete:\n\t\tn.competeTick(env, d)\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(hbTimer) && ev.Name[:len(hbTimer)] == hbTimer:\n\t\tn.heartbeat(env, ev.Name[len(hbTimer):])\n\tcase len(ev.Name) > len(deadTimer) && ev.Name[:len(deadTimer)] == deadTimer:\n\t\tn.localExpiry(env, ev.Name[len(deadTimer):])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) acquire(env *sim.Env, res string, ttl int64) {\n\tn.pending[res] = ttl\n\treq := proto.AcquireReq{Resource: res, TTL: ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"acq\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"ttl\": ttl})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Acquire, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startLeaseTimers(env *sim.Env, res string, h *hold) {\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\tenv.At(h.expiry, deadTimer+res, nil)\n}\n\n// markLost stops renewal activity. The stale fence token is deliberately kept\n// in the hold so that a zombie work loop can still attempt writes with it.\nfunc (n *Node) markLost(env *sim.Env, res string, reason string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.lost = true\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_lost\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) heartbeat(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil || h.lost {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\th.hbSeq++\n\treq := proto.RenewReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, TTL: h.ttl, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"ren\")}\n\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"attempt\": h.hbSeq})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Renew, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n\t// Schedule the next heartbeat independently of the reply: a dropped\n\t// response must not stop renewal. The interval is ttl/2, so one lost\n\t// renewal attempt is survived; several consecutive losses are not.\n\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\tinterval = 1\n\t}\n\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+res, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) localExpiry(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\tn.markLost(env, res, \"local_deadline_reached\")\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) submit(env *sim.Env, res, value string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_skipped\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"never_held\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif h.lost {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_stale\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value, \"reason\": \"node_continues_after_loss\",\n\t\t})\n\t} else {\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence, \"value\": value})\n\t}\n\treq := proto.SubmitReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, Value: value, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"sub\")}\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: n.resAddr(res), Method: proto.Submit, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) release(env *sim.Env, res string) {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\tif h == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treq := proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: res, Fence: h.fence, ReqID: n.nextReqID(\"rel\")}\n\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + res)\n\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + res)\n\tdelete(n.holds, res)\n\tenv.Record(\"client.release_sent\", map[string]any{\"resource\": res, \"fence\": h.fence})\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: n.id, To: LockServer, Method: proto.Release, Body: proto.Encode(req)})\n}\n\n// competeTick is one step of a fuzzing work loop: submit with whatever token\n// the node has (stale ones included, exercising the resource's defense) and\n// reschedule until count steps have run.\nfunc (n *Node) competeTick(env *sim.Env, d map[string]any) {\n\tres := dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + 1), \"count\": int64(count),\n\t\t\t\"interval\": interval, \"prefix\": prefix,\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.After(interval, CmdCompete, next)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleMessage(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tmsg := ev.Msg\n\tswitch msg.Method {\n\tcase proto.AcquireResp:\n\t\tvar r proto.LockResp\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &r); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !r.OK {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_denied\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"reason\": r.Reason})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif existing := n.holds[r.Resource]; existing != nil {\n\t\t\tif existing.fence == r.Fence {\n\t\t\t\treturn // duplicate delivery of the same grant\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif existing.fence > r.Fence {\n\t\t\t\t// Late grant for an old generation: never overwrite newer state.\n\t\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.acquire_ignored_stale\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"current_fence\": existing.fence})\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// A new, higher-fence generation replaces stale state.\n\t\t\tenv.CancelTimers(hbTimer + r.Resource)\n\t\t\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + r.Resource)\n\t\t}\n\t\tttl := n.pending[r.Resource]\n\t\tdelete(n.pending, r.Resource)\n\t\th := &hold{fence: r.Fence, ttl: ttl, expiry: r.Expiry}\n\t\tn.holds[r.Resource] = h\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.acquired\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"expiry\": r.Expiry})\n\t\tn.startLeaseTimers(env, r.Resource, h)\n\n\tcase proto.RenewResp:\n\t\tvar r proto.LockResp\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &r); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\th := n.holds[r.Resource]\n\t\tif h == nil {\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.renew_result_ignored\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"reason\": \"no_hold\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.OK {\n\t\t\th.expiry = r.Expiry\n\t\t\tenv.CancelTimers(deadTimer + r.Resource)\n\t\t\tenv.At(r.Expiry, deadTimer+r.Resource, nil)\n\t\t\tif h.lost {\n\t\t\t\t// A late OK for a still-valid token: the server only renews\n\t\t\t\t// the current holder, so the lease could not have been given\n\t\t\t\t// away in between. Resume the heartbeat.\n\t\t\t\th.lost = false\n\t\t\t\tinterval := h.ttl / 2\n\t\t\t\tif interval < 1 {\n\t\t\t\t\tinterval = 1\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tenv.After(interval, hbTimer+r.Resource, map[string]any{\"interval\": interval})\n\t\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.lock_recovered\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"expiry\": r.Expiry})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tenv.Record(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"resource\": r.Resource, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"expiry\": r.Expiry})\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.markLost(env, r.Resource, \"renew_denied:\"+r.Reason)\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase proto.SubmitResp:\n\t\tvar r proto.SubmitResp\n\t\tif err := proto.Decode(msg.Body, &r); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tenv.Record(\"client.submit_result\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"accepted\": r.Accepted, \"fence\": r.Fence, \"high_water\": r.HighWater,\n\t\t\t\"value\": r.Value, \"reason\": r.Reason, \"attempt\": msg.Attempt,\n\t\t})\n\n\tcase proto.ReleaseResp:\n\t\t// State already cleared; nothing further to do.\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":25,"oldLines":7,"newStart":25,"newLines":6,"lines":["   CmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"","   hbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"","   deadTimer   = \"deadline:\"","-  compTimer   = \"compete:\""," )"," "," // Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4d933f97-26c4-4ddc-9b09-4cb07e0ed1fe","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}

Exactly one command is meaningful per entry.\ntype Action struct {\n\tTime   int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tType   string `json:\"type\"`              // acquire|submit|release|pause|resume|add_rule|compete\n\tNode   string `json:\"node,omitempty\"`    // target client (or paused node)\n\tResource string `json:\"resource,omitempty\"`\n\tTTL    int64  `json:\"ttl,omitempty\"`\n\tValue  string `json:\"value,omitempty\"`\n\tUntil  int64  `json:\"until,omitempty\"`   // pause\n\tRule   *sim.Rule `json:\"rule,omitempty\"` // add_rule\n\tSteps  int Nodes communicate only through Message events; timers are\n// scheduled with At/After. The Network layer sits in front of delivery and may\n// drop, duplicate, delay or reorder messages. Pausing a node holds every event\n// destined for it (incoming network messages and its own timers) until resume,\n// which models a long GC pause / process stall: the rest of the world keeps\n// moving and lock leases can expire while the node is frozen.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// Message is the uniform envelope exchanged between handlers.\ntype Message struct {\n\tFrom    string         // sender node id\n\tTo      string         // recipient node id\n\tMethod  string         // application-level dispatch key\n\tBody    map[string]any // application payload\n\tAttempt int            // set by Network for duplicates (1 = original)\n}\n\n// Event is an item in the simulation queue. It is either a message delivery\n// (Msg != nil) or a timer firing (Kind == \"timer\").\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime int64\n\tSeq  int64\n\tKind string // \"message\" or \"timer\"\n\tMsg  *Message\n\tDest string\n\tName string // timer name / control tag\n\tData  map[string]any\n}\n\n// Handler is implemented by every simulated node or service.\ntype Handler interface {\n\tNodeID() string\n\tHandle(env *Env, ev *Event)\n}\n\n// Env is the interface a Handler uses to interact with the world.\ntype Env struct {\n\teng    *Engine\n\tSelfID string\n}\n\n// Now returns the current simulated time.\nfunc (e *Env) Now() int64 { return e.eng.Now() }\n\n// Send hands a message to the network for eventual delivery.\nfunc (e *Env) Send(m *Message) { e.eng.Send(m) }\n\n// At schedules a named timer at an absolute time. A timer with the same name\n// scheduled for the same node before the old one fires implicitly cancels the\n// old one; use unique names for independent timers.\nfunc (e *Env) At(t int64, name string, data map[string]any) {\n\te.eng.Schedule(t, e.SelfID, name, data)\n}\n\n// After schedules a named timer relative to now.\nfunc (e *Env) After(d int64, name string, data map[string]any) {\n\te.At(e.Now()+d, name, data)\n}\n\n// CancelTimers removes all pending timers with the given name for this node.\nfunc (e *Env) CancelTimers(name string) { e.eng.CancelTimers(e.SelfID, name) }\n\n// Pause freezes this node: every event bound for it is held until Resume.\nfunc (e *Env) Pause(until int64) { e.eng.Pause(e.SelfID, until) }\n\n// Record appends a trace record for this node.\nfunc (e *Env) Record(recType string, fields map[string]any) {\n\te.eng.Record(e.SelfID, recType, fields)\n}\n\n// Rng returns the engine's deterministic random source.\nfunc (e *Env) Rng() *Rng { return e.eng.rng }\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Record\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Record is one trace entry. Maps serialize directly to JSON.\ntype Record struct {\n\tTime   int64          `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode   string         `json:\"node\"`\n\tType   string         `json:\"type\"`\n\tFields map[string]any `json:\"fields\"`\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Event heap\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].Seq < h[j].Seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)   { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\tit := old[n-1]\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn it\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Engine\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Engine owns the clock, the event queue, the node table and the network.\ntype Engine struct {\n\thq     eventHeap\n\tseq    int64\n\tnow    int64\n\tnodes  map[string]Handler\n\tnet    *Network\n\trng    *Rng\n\ttraces []Record\n\tended  bool\n\n\tpaused map[string]bool\n\tuntil  map[string]int64\n\theld   map[string][]*Event\n}\n\n// New creates an engine. seed drives the deterministic RNG used by the network\n// and by application workloads.\nfunc New(seed int64, cfg NetConfig) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:  map[string]Handler{},\n\t\tpaused: map[string]bool{},\n\t\tuntil:  map[string]int64{},\n\t\theld:   map[string][]*Event{},\n\t}\n\te.rng = NewRng(seed)\n\te.net = NewNetwork(e, cfg)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Register adds a handler. Must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) Register(h Handler) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[h.NodeID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"sim: duplicate node id %q\", h.NodeID()))\n\t}\n\te.nodes[h.NodeID()] = h\n}\n\n// Rng exposes the deterministic RNG to the runner.\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\n// Network exposes the network so rules can be added at runtime.\nfunc (e *Engine) Network() *Network { return e.net }\n\n// Now returns the current simulated time.\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// Records returns a copy of all trace records collected so far.\nfunc (e *Engine) Records() []Record {\n\tout := make([]Record, len(e.traces))\n\tcopy(out, e.traces)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Record appends a trace record attributed to node.\nfunc (e *Engine) Record(node, recType string, fields map[string]any) {\n\tif fields == nil {\n\t\tfields = map[string]any{}\n\t}\n\te.traces = append(e.traces, Record{Time: e.now, Node: node, Type: recType, Fields: fields})\n}\n\n// push queues an event, stamping it with the next global sequence number so\n// events at the same timestamp have a total, insertion-derived order.\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *Event) {\n\te.seq++\n\tev.Seq = e.seq\n\theap.Push(&e.hq, ev)\n}\n\n// Send routes a message through the network; the network decides when (and\n// whether) the delivery event is queued.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(m *Message) {\n\tif m.Attempt == 0 {\n\t\tm.Attempt = 1\n\t}\n\te.net.Route(m)\n}\n\n// deliver is called by the Network for each copy of a message it releases.\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(at int64, m *Message) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: at, Kind: \"message\", Msg: m, Dest: m.To}\n\tif e.paused[m.To] {\n\t\te.held[m.To] = append(e.held[m.To], ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.push(ev)\n}\n\n// Schedule queues a timer for node.\nfunc (e *Engine) Schedule(t int64, node, name string, data map[string]any) {\n\tif t < e.now {\n\t\tt = e.now\n\t}\n\tev := &Event{Time: t, Kind: \"timer\", Dest: node, Name: name, Data: data}\n\tif e.paused[node] {\n\t\te.held[node] = append(e.held[node], ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.push(ev)\n}\n\n// CancelTimers drops queued, not-yet-fired timers with the given name.\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimers(node, name string) {\n\tout := e.hq[:0]\n\tfor _, ev := range e.hq {\n\t\tif ev.Kind == \"timer\" && ev.Dest == node && ev.Name == name {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, ev)\n\t}\n\te.hq = out\n\theap.Init(&e.hq)\n}\n\n// Pause freezes node and schedules its automatic resume at until. Events for a\n// paused node are buffered (in arrival order) and released at resume.\nfunc (e *Engine) Pause(node string, until int64) {\n\tif e.paused[node] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.paused[node] = true\n\te.until[node] = until\n\tif until > e.now {\n\t\te.push(&Event{Time: until, Kind: \"control\", Dest: node, Name: \"resume\"})\n\t}\n\te.Record(node, \"node.paused\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n}\n\n// resume releases all events held during a pause. Buffered events keep their\n// original (time, arrival) order but are all re-enqueued at the resume time:\n// a message whose send time predates the pause now visibly \"arrives late\".\nfunc (e *Engine) resume(node string) {\n\tif !e.paused[node] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.paused[node] = false\n\tdelete(e.until, node)\n\theld := e.held[node]\n\tdelete(e.held, node)\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = e.now\n\t\tev.Seq = 0\n\t\te.push(ev)\n\t}\n\te.Record(node, \"node.resumed\", map[string]any{\"held_events\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// IsPaused reports whether node is currently frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) IsPaused(node string) bool { return e.paused[node] }\n\n// End terminates the run at the current time even if events remain.\nfunc (e *Engine) End() { e.ended = true }\n\n// Run advances the simulation until no events remain, maxTime is reached\n// (timers exactly at maxTime still fire), or End is called.\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(maxTime int64) {\n\tfor e.hq.Len() > 0 && !e.ended {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.hq).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Auto-resume is an engine event: it must fire even though the\n\t\t// {\n\t\t\t\te.resume(ev.Dest)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Defensive: nothing should reach here for a paused node because\n\t\t// deliver/Schedule buffer it, but keep the invariant \"fence_too_old\"\n\tcase req.Fence == r.high:\n\t\taccept, reason = false, \"duplicate_fence\"\n\tcase r.seenReq[req.ReqID]:\n\t\taccept, reason = false, \"duplicate_request\"\n\t}\n\n\tif accept {\n\tres := &Result{Name: sc.Name, Seed: sc.Seed, EndTime: eng.Now(), Traces: eng.Records()}\n\n\t// Commits from each fenced resource, in acceptance order.\n\tfor _, rc := range sc.Resources {\n\t\tr := resByName[rc.Name]\n\t\tfor _, e := range r.Log() {\n\t\t\tres.Commits = append(res.Commits, Commit{\n\t\t\t\tTime: e.Time, Resource: rc.Name, Node: e.Node, Fence: e.Fence, Value: e.Value,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Built-in invariants, checked for every fenced resource.\n\tfor _, rc := range sc.Resources {\n\t\tr := resByName[rc.Name]\n\t\tvar prev int64\n\t\tvar prevNode string\n\t\tfor i, e := range r.Log() {\n\t\t\tif i > 0 && e.Fence <= prev {\n\t\t\t\tres.Checks = append(res.Checks, Check{\n\t\t\t\t\tKind: \"fence_monotonic\",\n\t\t\t\t\tPass: false,\n\t\t\t\t\tDetail: fmt.Sprintf(\"resource %s: fence %d after %d at t=%d (%s)\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\trc.Name, e.Fence, prev, e.Time, e.Node),\n\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tprev = e.Fence\n\t\t\tprevNode = e.Node\n\t\t}\n\t\tif rc.Fenced && len(r.Log()) > 0 {\n\t\t\tres.Checks = append(res.Checks, Check{\n\t\t\t\tKind:   \"fence_monotonic\",\n\t\t\t\tPass:   true,\n\t\t\t\tDetail: fmt.Sprintf(\"resource %s: %d commits, fences strictly increasing\", rc.Name, len(r.Log())),\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t_ = prevNode\n\n\t// Explicit expectations.\n\tfor _, ex := range sc.Expect {\n\t\tres.Checks = append(res.Checks, evalExpect(ex, eng.Records(), res))\n\t}\n\n\tres.OK = true\n\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\tres.OK = false\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc findRecords(records []sim.Record, node, recType string) []sim.Record {\n\tvar out []sim.Record\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tif node != \"\" && r.Node != node {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif recType != \"\" && r.Type != recType {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, r)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc evalAcceptOrder(ex Expect, res *Result) Check {\n\tvar got []string\n\tfor _, c := range res.Commits {\n\t\tif ex.Resource != \"\" && c.Resource != ex.Resource {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tgot = append(got, c.Node)\n\t}\n\tpass := len(got) == len(ex.Order)\n\tif pass {\n\t\tfor i := range got {\n\t\t\tif got[i] != ex.Order[i] {\n\t\t\t\tpass = false\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tdetail := fmt.Sprintf(\"resource=%s accepted node order=%v expected=%v\", ex.Resource, got, ex.Order)\n\treturn Check{Kind: ex.Kind, Pass: pass, Detail: detail}\n}\n\nfunc evalExpect(ex Expect, records []sim.Record, res *Result) Check {\n\tswitch ex.Kind {\n\tcase \"record_count\":\n\t\trs := findRecords(records, ex.Node, ex.Type)\n\t\tn := len(rs)\n\t\tpass := true\n\t\tdetail := findRecords(records, ex.Node, ex.Type)\n\t\treturn Check{Kind: ex.Kind, Pass: len(rs) > 0,\n\t\t\tDetail: fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%s found=%d\", ex.Node, ex.Type, len(rs))}\n\n\tcase \"record_absent\":\n\t\trs := findRecords(records, ex.Node, ex.Type)\n\t\treturn Check{Kind: ex.Kind, Pass: len(rs) == 0,\n\t\t\tDetail: fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%s found=%d\", ex.Node, ex.Type,
