{"parentUuid":"275cb762-8c84-4d6d-b7c3-e4d43ed7e564","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_81lu4ukrxx5la3ltgfz3vgs1","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b/cmd/fls/demos.go","content":"package main\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/runner\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// demos maps a built-in name to a scenario builder. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock; a burst of lost renewal messages lets its\n// lease expire. The server refuses the late renew, grants the lock to B\n// (fence 2), and A's stale write with fence 1 is rejected by the resource.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 30, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 31, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 32, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"drop-renew-1\", Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"drop-renew-2\", Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 2},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"53e0dd7a-5989-45c7-910f-b6923349ae84","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}

Its writes carry the stale\n// token; only the resource's high-water-mark check stops them.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Timer/command names used when runner schedules work for a node.\nconst (\n\tCmdAcquire  = \"cmd.acquire\"\n\tCmdSubmit   = \"cmd.submit\"\n\tCmdRelease  = \"cmd.release\"\n\tCmdCompete  = \"cmd.compete\"\n\thbTimer     = \"heartbeat:\"\n\tdeadTimer   = \"deadline:\"\n)\n\n// Server addresses are fixed ids, registered by the runner.\nconst (\n\tLockServer = \"lockserver\"\n)\n\ntype hold struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\tttl      int64\n\texpiry   int64 // local view of the absolute expiry\n\tlost     bool  // node knows the lease is gone\n\thbSeq    int   // renew request counter\n}\n\n// Node is a simulated client.\ntype Node struct {\n\tid        string\n\tresAddr   func(resource string) string // map resource name -> resource node id\n\tholds     map[string]*hold\n\tpending   map[string]int64 // ttl of the in-flight acquire per resource\n\treqSeq    int\n}\n\n// New creates a client. resAddr resolves a resource name to its node id.\nfunc New(id string, resAddr func(string) string) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{id: id, resAddr: resAddr, holds: map[string]*hold{}, pending: map[string]int64{}}\n}\n\n// NodeID implements sim.Handler.\nfunc (n *Node) NodeID() string { return n.id }\n\n// HasFence reports the fence token the node currently associates with res.\nfunc (n *Node) HasFence(res string) int64 {\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fence\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// BelievesHeld reports whether the node still considers itself the holder.\nfunc (n *Node) BelievesHeld(res string) bool {\n\th := n.holds[res]\n\treturn h != nil && !h.lost\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tn.reqSeq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s#%s-%d\", n.id, kind, n.reqSeq)\n}\n\nfunc dataString(d map[string]any, k string) string {\n\tif v, ok := d[k]; dataString(d, \"resource\")\n\tstep := int(dataInt64(d, \"step\"))\n\tcount := int(dataInt64(d, \"count\"))\n\tinterval := dataInt64(d, \"interval\")\n\tprefix := dataString(d, \"prefix\")\n\tif h := n.holds[res]; h != nil && step < count {\n\t\tvalue := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%d\", prefix, step)\n\t\tn.submit(env, res, value)\n\t\tnext := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"resource\": res, \"step\": int64(step + existing.fence == r.Fence {\n\t\t\t\treturn // duplicate delivery of the same grant\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif existing.fence > r.Fence {\n\t\t\t\t// Late grant for an old generation: never overwrite newer Its only defense is the fence token carried by every write:\n// it remembers the largest token it has ever accepted and rejects any write\n// presenting a smaller one. That single rule is what makes a paused/stale lock\n// holder harmless even if the client believes it still owns the lock.\n//\n// Fenced controls the policy. Fenced=true (the real system): token must be\n// strictly greater than the high-water mark; duplicate writes with the same\n// token are also rejected, so each successful write appears exactly once and\n// in token order. Fenced=false models the naive baseline used by the\n// no-fencing demo, where any non-zero token is accepted.\npackage resource\n\nimport (\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// Entry is one accepted write.\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTime  int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tFence int64 (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/runner\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// demos maps a built-in name to a scenario builder. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock; a burst of lost renewal messages lets its\n// lease expire. The server refuses the late renew, grants the lock to B\n// (fence 2), and A's stale write with fence 1 is rejected by the resource.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 30, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 31, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 32, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"drop-renew-1\", Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"drop-renew-2\", Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 2},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=10 and renews every 5 ticks, so a\n// single lost renewal is survivable. Three consecutive renewal losses are not:\n// the lease expires at t=10, the server rejects every later renewal carrying\n// fence 1, grants B a fresh fence 2, and the resource turns away A's stale\n// writes.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":52,"oldLines":8,"newStart":52,"newLines":8,"lines":["       drop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),","       drop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),","       {Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},","-      {Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},","-      {Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},","+      {Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},","+      {Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},","     },","     Expect: []runner.Expect{","       {Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d78642e0-88d0-4567-906e-3e9d88e100be","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}

All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=10 and renews every 5 ticks, so a\n// single lost renewal is survivable. Three consecutive renewal losses are not:\n// the lease expires at t=10, the server rejects every later renewal carrying\n// fence 1, grants B a fresh fence 2, and the resource turns away A's stale\n// writes.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 13, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=10 and renews every 5 ticks, so a\n// single lost renewal is survivable. Three consecutive renewal losses are not:\n// the lease expires at t=10, the server rejects every later renewal carrying\n// fence 1, grants B a fresh fence 2, and the resource turns away A's stale\n// writes.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 17, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":165,"oldLines":7,"newStart":165,"newLines":7,"lines":["       {Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},","       {Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},","       {Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},","-      {Time: 14, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},","+      {Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},","       {Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},","     },","     Expect: []runner.Expect{"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"bf3a167c-9617-48db-adab-bfb70656457c","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}
