Three consecutive renewal losses are not:\n// the lease expires at t=10, the server rejects every later renewal carrying\n// fence 1, grants B a fresh fence 2, and the resource turns away A's stale\n// writes.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}","newString":"// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks\n// (ttl/2), so one or even two lost renewals are survivable; losing the first\n// two renewals leaves the third arriving just after the lease expires. The\n// server rejects the late renewal carrying fence 1, grants B fence 2, and the\n// resource turns away A's stale write.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}","originalFile":"package main\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/runner\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// demos maps a built-in name to a scenario builder. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=10 and renews every 5 ticks, so a\n// single lost renewal is survivable. Three consecutive renewal losses are not:\n// the lease expires at t=10, the server rejects every later renewal carrying\n// fence 1, grants B a fresh fence 2, and the resource turns away A's stale\n// writes.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(3, \"drop-renew-3\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 17, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":26,"oldLines":11,"newStart":26,"newLines":11,"lines":[" "," func ip(i int) *int { return &i }"," ","-// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=10 and renews every 5 ticks, so a","-// single lost renewal is survivable. The\n// server rejects the late renewal carrying fence 1, grants B fence 2, and the\n// resource turns away A's stale write.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}","newString":"// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks\n// (ttl/2). Its first renewal is lost in the network long enough to arrive\n// after the lease has expired: the server rejects it (lease_expired), the\n// local deadline also fires, B acquires fence 2, and the resource turns away\n// A's stale write. A healthy path (the duplicate demo) shows that a renewal\n// arriving before expiry extends the lease instead.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"lose-first-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 12,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"network\", Type: \"net.delay\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}","originalFile":"package main\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/runner\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// demos maps a built-in name to a scenario builder. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks\n// (ttl/2), so one or even two lost renewals are survivable; losing the first\n// two renewals leaves the third arriving just after the lease expires. The\n// server rejects the late renewal carrying fence 1, grants B fence 2, and the\n// resource turns away A's stale write.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tdrop := func(nth int, name string) runner.Action {\n\t\treturn runner.Action{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\tName: name, Action: \"drop\",\n\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: nth},\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\tdrop(1, \"drop-renew-1\"),\n\t\t\tdrop(2, \"drop-renew-2\"),\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 17, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":27,"oldLines":17,"newStart":27,"newLines":12,"lines":[" func ip(i int) *int { return &i }"," "," // demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks","-// (ttl/2), so one or even two lost renewals are survivable; losing the first","-// two renewals leaves the third arriving just after the lease expires.  int\n}\n\nfunc (m *multiSender) NodeID() string { return m.from }\nfunc (m *multiSender) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind == \"timer\" && m.n < len(m.times) ev.Time)\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tp.got = append(p.got, ev.Time)\n\t}\n}\n\n// sender emits one message (\"ping\" by default) each time a \"go\" timer fires.\ntype sender struct {\n\tid, to, method string\n\tn              int\n}\n\nfunc (s *sender) NodeID() string { return s.id }\nfunc (s *sender) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind == \"timer\" {\n\t\ts.n++\n\t\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: s.id, To: s.to, Method: s.method})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTimersFireInTimeOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\tp := &probe{id: \"p\"}\n\teng.Register(p)\n\teng.Schedule(50, \"p\", \"late\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(10, \"p\", \"early\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(30, \"p\", \"mid\", nil)\n\teng.Run(100)\n\twant := []int64{10, 30, 50}\n\tif len(p.times) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d timer fires, want 3\", len(p.times))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range want {\n\t\tif p.times[i] != want[i] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"timer order %v, want %v\", p.times, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRNGDeterministicAcrossInstances(t *testing.T) {\n\tr1, r2 := sim.NewRng(42), sim.NewRng(42)\n\tfor i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {\n\t\tif r1.Uint32() != r2.Uint32() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"RNG streams diverge at %d\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tr3 := sim.NewRng(43)\n\tdiff := false\n\tfor i := 0; i < 10; i++ {\n\t\tif r1.Uint32() != r3.Uint32() {\n\t\t\tdiff = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !diff {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"different seeds produced identical streams\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkDropRule(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tAction: \"drop\", Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\"},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\ts := &sender{id: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\"}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"go\", nil)\n\teng.Run(10)\n\tif len(b.got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"dropped message was delivered: %v\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkDelayRule(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tAction: \"delay\", Delay: 9, Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\"},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\ts := &sender{id: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\"}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"go\", nil)\n\teng.Run(20)\n\tif len(b.got) != 1 || b.got[0] != 9 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"message should arrive at t=9, got %v\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkDuplicateRule(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tAction: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 3, Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\"},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\ts := &sender{id: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\"}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"go\", nil)\n\teng.Run(20)\n\tif len(b.got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 2 deliveries, got %d at %v\", len(b.got), b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkNthMatchTargetsOneOccurrence(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tName: \"only-second\", Action: \"drop\", Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\", Nth: 2},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\ts := &sender{id: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\"}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"go\", sim.NetConfig{})\n\ttype canceler struct {\n\t\tprobe\n\t}\n\tp := &probe{id: \"p\"}\n\teng.Register(p)\n\teng.Schedule(5, \"p\", \"keep\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(6, \"p\", \"drop\", }"]}],"originalFile":"package sim_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\ntype probe struct {\n\tid    string\n\tgot   []int64\n\ttimes []int64\n}\n\nfunc (p *probe) NodeID() string { return p.id }\nfunc (p *probe) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"timer\":\n\t\tp.times = append(p.times, env.Now())\n\tcase \"message\":\n\t\tp.got = append(p.got, env.Now())\n\t\tif reply, ok := ev.Msg.Body[\"reply\"].(int64); ok {\n\t\t\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: p.id, To: ev.Msg.From, Method: \"pong\", Body: map[string]any{\"n\": reply}})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTimersFireInTimeOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\tp := &probe{id: \"p\"}\n\teng.Register(p)\n\teng.Schedule(50, \"p\", \"late\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(10, \"p\", \"early\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(30, \"p\", \"mid\", nil)\n\teng.Run(100)\n\twant := []int64{10, 30, 50}\n\tif len(p.times) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d timer fires, want 3\", len(p.times))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range want {\n\t\tif p.times[i] != want[i] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"timer order %v, want %v\", p.times, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestDeterminismSameSeed(t *testing.T) {\n\trun := func(seed int64) []sim.Record {\n\t\teng := sim.New(seed, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3, LossProb: 0.3, DuplicateProb: 0.2, ReorderProb: 0.2})\n\t\ta, b := &probe{id: \"a\"}, &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\t\teng.Register(a)\n\t\teng.Register(b)\n\t\tfor i := int64(0); i < 20; i++ {\n\t\t\teng.Schedule(i, \"a\", \"send\", nil)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// send on each tick using a self-perpetuating timer would need node\n\t\t// logic; instead schedule direct sends through a tiny handler loop.\n\t\teng.Run(40)\n\t\treturn eng.Records()\n\t}\n\t_ = run\n\t// Determinism is verified at the scenario level in runner tests; here we\n\t// at least pin the RNG stream.\n\tr1, r2 := sim.NewRng(42), sim.NewRng(42)\n\tfor i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {\n\t\tif r1.Uint32() != r2.Uint32() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"RNG streams diverge at %d\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkDrop(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tAction: \"drop\", Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\"},\n\t}}})\n\ta, b := &probe{id: \"a\"}, &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(a)\n\teng.Register(b)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"send1\", nil)\n\t// deliver the message manually via the engine at run start through a\n\t// timer callback: easiest is sending from handler. Use a tiny sender.\n\ts := &sender{from: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\", at: 0}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Run(10)\n\tif len(b.got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"dropped message was delivered: %v\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\ntype sender struct {\n\tfrom, to, method string\n\tat               int64\n\tdone             bool\n}\n\nfunc (s *sender) NodeID() string { return s.from }\nfunc (s *sender) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif !s.done && ev.Kind == \"timer\" {\n\t\ts.done = true\n\t\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: s.from, To: s.to, Method: s.method})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tAction: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 3, Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\"},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\ts := &sender{from: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\"}\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Schedule(0, \"a\", \"go\", nil)\n\teng.Run(20)\n\tif len(b.got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 2 deliveries, got %d at %v\", len(b.got), b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNetworkNthMatch(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, Rules: []*sim.Rule{{\n\t\tName: \"only-second\", Action: \"drop\", Match: sim.Match{Method: \"ping\", Nth: 2},\n\t}}})\n\tb := &probe{id: \"b\"}\n\teng.Register(b)\n\tms := &multiSender{from: \"a\", to: \"b\", method: \"ping\", times: []int64{0, 2, 4}}\n\teng.Register(ms)\n\tfor _, tt := range ms.times {\n\t\teng.Schedule(tt, \"a\", \"go\", nil)\n\t}\n\teng.Run(20)\n\tif len(b.got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 2 deliveries (2nd dropped), got %d at %v\", len(b.got), b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\ntype multiSender struct {\n\tfrom, to, method string\n\ttimes            []int64\n\tn                int\n}\n\nfunc (m *multiSender) NodeID() string { return m.from }\nfunc (m *multiSender) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind == \"timer\" && m.n < len(m.times) {\n\t\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: m.from, To: m.to, Method: m.method})\n\t\tm.n++\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPauseHoldsEventsAndFreesOnResume verifies that while a node is paused\n// neither messages nor timers reach it, and everything flushes at resume in\n// original order.\nfunc TestPauseHoldsEventsAndFreesOnResume(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1})\n\tp := &probe{id: \"p\"}\n\teng.Register(p)\n\tms := &multiSender{from: \"x\", to: \"p\", method: \"ping\", times: nil}\n\teng.Register(ms)\n\teng.Schedule(2, \"p\", \"timer-before\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(5, \"p\", \"timer-during\", nil)\n\n\t// Pause p from t=1 until t=10.\n\teng.Schedule(1, \"control\", \"do-pause\", nil)\n\teng.Run(0) // cannot pause before run via schedule; use engine directly after setup\n\t_ = ms\n\n\t// Simpler: pause through engine API before run starts.\n\teng2 := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1})\n\tq := &probe{id: \"q\"}\n\teng2.Register(q)\n\teng2.Register(&multiSender{from: \"x\", to: \"q\", method: \"ping\"})\n\teng2.Pause(\"q\", 10)\n\teng2.Schedule(3, \"q\", \"frozen-timer\", nil)\n\t// a message sent at t=2 (1 tick delay -> t=3) should be buffered\n\teng2.Schedule(2, \"x\", \"go\", nil)\n\teng2.Run(20)\n\tif len(q.times) != 1 || q.times[0] != 10 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"held timer should fire at resume t=10, got %v\", q.times)\n\t}\n\tif len(q.got) != 1 || q.got[0] != 10 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"held message should be delivered at resume t=10, got %v\", q.got)\n\t}\n\trecs := eng2.Records()\n\tvar resumed bool\n\tfor _, r := range recs {\n\t\tif r.Type == \"node.resumed\" && r.Node == \"q\" {\n\t\t\tresumed = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !resumed {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected node.resumed trace\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestExplicitResume(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\tp := &probe{id: \"p\"}\n\teng.Register(p)\n\teng.Pause(\"p\", 100)\n\teng.Schedule(3, \"p\", \"t\", nil)\n\teng.Schedule(5, \"control\", \"wake\", nil)\n\tc := &waker{target: \"p\", eng: eng}\n\teng.Register(c)\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif len(p.times) != 1 || p.times[0] != 5 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"explicit resume should flush timer at t=5, got %v\", p.times)\n\t}\n}\n\ntype waker struct {\n\ttarget string\n\teng    *sim.Engine\n}\n\nfunc (w *waker) NodeID() string { return \"control\" }\nfunc (w *waker) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind == \"timer\" {\n\t\tenv.Resume(w.target)\n\t}\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"470e1a4f-4435-4534-8063-a77507cc683f","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}

{"parentUuid":"4c9311a4-1da2-4e0d-ad8a-22658aa7f7dd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_05q7azw40byfsoo2fjh4hqk6","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b/internal/lock/service_test.go","content":"package lock_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/lock\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/proto\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// sink receives the server's replies; it never pauses.\ntype sink struct{ id string }\n\nfunc (s sink) NodeID() string                        { return s.id }\nfunc (s sink) Handle(*sim.Env, *sim.Event)           {}\n\nfunc send(eng *sim.Engine, from, method string, body any) {\n\teng.Send(&sim.Message{From: from, To: \"lockserver\", Method: method, Body: proto.Encode(body)})\n}\n\n// replies collects lock replies of a given method after a run.\nfunc collect(eng *sim.Engine, method string) []sim.Record {\n\tvar out []sim.Record\n\tfor _, r := range eng.Records() {\n\t\tif r.Node == \"lockserver\" {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, r)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc granted(eng *sim.Engine) []int64 {\n\tvar fs []int64\n\tfor _, r := range eng.Records() {\n\t\tif r.Type == \"lock.granted\" {\n\t\t\tif v, ok := r.Fields[\"fence\"].(int64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfs = append(fs, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn fs\n}\n\nfunc setup() (*sim.Engine, *lock.Service) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\ts := lock.New(\"lockserver\")\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Register(sink{id: \"A\"})\n\teng.Register(sink{id: \"B\"})\n\treturn eng, s\n}\n\nfunc TestFenceTokensIncreasePerAcquisition(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\t// A acquires r1 (fence 1), releases; B acquires r1 (fence 2).\n\t// Acquire at t=0.\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Release, proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: \"r1\", Fence: 1, ReqID: \"ar1\"})\n\teng.Run(3)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(5)\n\tfs := granted(eng)\n\tif len(fs) != 2 || fs[0] != 1 || fs[1] != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected fences [1 2], got %v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestAcquireConflictWhileHeld(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); len(fs) != 1 || fs[0] != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"B must be rejected while A holds; grants=%v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestExpiredLeaseAllowsNewFence(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 5, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1) // acquired, expiry 6\n\teng.Run(6) // past expiry\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 5, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(7)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfs = append(fs, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn fs\n}\n\nfunc setup() (*sim.Engine, *lock.Service) {\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\ts := lock.New(\"lockserver\")\n\teng.Register(s)\n\teng.Register(sink{id: \"A\"})\n\teng.Register(sink{id: \"B\"})\n\treturn eng, s\n}\n\nfunc TestFenceTokensIncreasePerAcquisition(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\t// A acquires r1 (fence 1), releases; B acquires r1 (fence 2).\n\t// Acquire at t=0.\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Release, proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: \"r1\", Fence: 1, ReqID: \"ar1\"})\n\teng.Run(3)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(5)\n\tfs := granted(eng)\n\tif len(fs) != 2 || fs[0] != 1 || fs[1] != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected fences [1 2], got %v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestAcquireConflictWhileHeld(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); len(fs) != 1 || fs[0] != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"B must be rejected while A holds; grants=%v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestExpiredLeaseAllowsNewFence(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 5, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1) // acquired, expiry 6\n\teng.Run(6) // past expiry\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 5, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(7)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); len(fs) != 2 || fs[1] != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected regrant with fence 2 after expiry, got %v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRenewStaleFenceRejected(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 5, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1)\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Release, proto.ReleaseReq{Resource: \"r1\", Fence: 1, ReqID: \"ar\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 20, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(3)\n\t// A (old holder) tries to renew fence 1.\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Renew, proto.RenewReq{Resource: \"r1\", Fence: 1, TTL: 10, ReqID: \"ax\"})\n\teng.Run(4)\n\tvar rejected bool\n\tfor _, r := range collect(eng, \"\") {\n\t\tif r.Type == \"lock.renew_rejected\" && r.Fields[\"reason\"] == \"fencing_token_stale\" {\n\t\t\trejected = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !rejected {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"renewal with stale fence must be rejected fencing_token_stale\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestDuplicateAcquireIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"same\"})\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 50, ReqID: \"same\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); len(fs) != 1 || fs[0] != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"duplicated acquire must not mint a second fence, got %v\", fs)\n\t}\n\tvar cached int\n\tfor _, r := range eng.Records() {\n\t\tif r.Type == \"lock.served_from_cache\" {\n\t\t\tcached++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif cached != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 1 cache-served duplicate, got %d\", cached)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRenewExtendsExpiry(t *testing.T) {\n\teng, _ := setup()\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"a1\"})\n\teng.Run(1)\n\tsend(eng, \"A\", proto.Renew, proto.RenewReq{Resource: \"r1\", Fence: 1, TTL: 10, ReqID: \"r1\"})\n\teng.Run(2)\n\t// Without renewal A's lease would end at t=11; B acquiring at t=15 fails.\n\teng.Run(15)\n\tsend(eng, \"B\", proto.Acquire, proto.AcquireReq{Resource: \"r1\", TTL: 10, ReqID: \"b1\"})\n\teng.Run(16)\n\tif fs := granted(eng); len(fs) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"renewed lease should still block B at t=15, grants=%v\", fs)\n\t}\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5a89b2d5-b3bd-482f-b1a7-0ac72a934bcc","session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}

times.\ntype scripted struct {\n\tid string\n\tsteps []scriptedStep\n}\n\ntype scriptedStep struct {\n\tat     int64\n\tmethod string\n\tbody   any\n}\n\nfunc (s *scripted) NodeID() string { return s.id }\nfunc (s *scripted) Handle(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind != \"timer\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tstep := ev.Data[\"step\"].(scriptedStep)\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: s.id, To: \"lockserver\", Method: step.method, Body: proto.Encode(step.body)})\n}\n\nfunc (s *scripted) schedule(eng *sim.Engine) {\n\tfor i, st := range s.steps {\n\t\ti := i\n\t\t_ = i\n\t\teng.Schedule(st.at, s.id, \"step\", map[string]any{\"i\": i})\n\t}\n}\n\n// The Data map must carry the step value directly.\nfunc (s *scripted) schedule2(eng *sim.Engine) {\n\tfor _, st := range s.steps {\n\t\tst := st\n\t\teng.Schedule(st.at, s.id, \"step2\", map[string]any{})\n\t\t_ = st\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc setup(t *testing.T) (*sim.Engine, *lock.Service) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\teng := sim.New(1, sim.NetConfig{})\n\ts := lock.New(\"lockserver\")\n\teng.Register(s)\n\treturn eng, s\n}\n\nfunc newClient(eng *sim.Engine, id string, steps []scriptedStep) *scripted {\n\tc := &scripted{id: id, steps: steps}\n\teng.Register(c)\n\tfor i := range steps {\n\t\teng.Schedule(steps[i].at, id, \"send\", map[string]any{\"idx\": int64(i)})\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (s *scripted) handle2(env *sim.Env, ev *sim.Event) {\n\tif ev.Kind != \"timer\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tidx := ev.Data[\"idx\"].(int64)\n\tst := s.steps[idx]\n\tenv.Send(&sim.Message{From: s.id, To: \"lockserver\", Method: st.method, Body: proto.Encode(st.body)})\n}\n\nfunc grantedFences(eng *sim.Engine) []int64 {\n\tvar fs []int64\n\tfor _, r := range eng.Records() {\n\t\tif r.Type == \"lock.granted\" All randomness","originalFile":"package main\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/runner\"\n\t\"fencinglease/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// demos maps a built-in name to a scenario builder. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks\n// (ttl/2). Its first renewal is lost in the network long enough to arrive\n// after the lease has expired: the server rejects it (lease_expired), the\n// local deadline also fires, B acquires fence 2, and the resource turns away\n// A's stale write. A healthy path (the duplicate demo) shows that a renewal\n// arriving before expiry extends the lease instead.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"lose-first-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 12,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"network\", Type: \"net.delay\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 17, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\n// used at runtime flows from the seed via the simulator RNG; the shape itself\n// is generated deterministically from s so failures are reproducible.\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":225,"oldLines":8,"newStart":225,"newLines":6,"lines":[" }"," "," // buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All times are ticks.\n// Common layout: ttl=10, heartbeat every 5, zero-delay reliable network unless\n// a rule says otherwise, so traces are easy to read.\nvar demos = map[string]func(seed int64) *runner.Scenario{\n\t\"renew-lost\":    demoRenewLost,\n\t\"pause-expired\": demoPauseExpired,\n\t\"late-message\":  demoLateMessage,\n\t\"duplicate\":     demoDuplicate,\n\t\"no-fence\":      demoNoFence,\n}\n\nfunc baseNet() sim.NetConfig {\n\treturn sim.NetConfig{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 0}\n}\n\nfunc ip(i int) *int { return &i }\n\n// demoRenewLost: A holds the lock with ttl=15 and renews every ~7 ticks\n// (ttl/2). Its first renewal is lost in the network long enough to arrive\n// after the lease has expired: the server rejects it (lease_expired), the\n// local deadline also fires, B acquires fence 2, and the resource turns away\n// A's stale write. A healthy path (the duplicate demo) shows that a renewal\n// arriving before expiry extends the lease instead.\nfunc demoRenewLost(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"renewal-lost\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 70,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 6, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-while-held\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"lose-first-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 12,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 15},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-wins\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 21, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"network\", Type: \"net.delay\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)}, // the t=6 write\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoPauseExpired: A is paused longer than its lease. On resume it is a\n// zombie holding fence 1 while B legitimately holds fence 2.\nfunc demoPauseExpired(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"pause-longer-than-lease\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-after-pause\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-zombie\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"A\", Type: \"client.lock_lost\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"last_water\", Resource: \"acct\", Equals: 2},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoLateMessage: A's renewal message is held in the network and only\n// arrives after the lease has expired and B has acquired fence 2. The late\n// renew is refused and A's delayed write is rejected.\nfunc demoLateMessage(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"late-message\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"hold-renew\", Action: \"delay\", Delay: 8,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t\t{Time: 11, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 15, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-new-holder\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 17, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-late\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.renew_rejected\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"B\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Field: \"fence_too_old\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoDuplicate: a renewal RPC is duplicated in the network. Server-side\n// request deduplication means the lease is extended exactly once and no\n// state is corrupted; A's writes continue to be accepted.\nfunc demoDuplicate(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"duplicate-renew\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 30,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-ok\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"add_rule\", Rule: &sim.Rule{\n\t\t\t\tName: \"dup-renew\", Action: \"duplicate\", DupDelay: 2,\n\t\t\t\tMatch: sim.Match{From: \"A\", To: \"lockserver\", Method: \"lock.renew\", Nth: 1},\n\t\t\t}},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"records_exist\", Node: \"lockserver\", Type: \"lock.served_from_cache\"},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"rejected\", Resource: \"acct\", Min: ip(0), Max: ip(0)},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// demoNoFence is the control experiment: the resource ignores fence tokens.\n// A is paused past its lease, B takes over and writes, then zombie A writes\n// with the old token — and it is accepted, corrupting order. The built-in\n// monotonicity invariant FAILS here by design.\nfunc demoNoFence(seed int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    \"no-fencing-baseline-fails\",\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\tMaxTime: 60,\n\t\tNetwork: baseNet(),\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: false}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 4, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 22},\n\t\t\t{Time: 12, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 10},\n\t\t\t{Time: 16, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"b-legit\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 24, Type: \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Value: \"a-stale-corrupts\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\tExpect: []runner.Expect{\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted\", Resource: \"acct\", Node: \"A\", Min: ip(1)},\n\t\t\t{Kind: \"accepted_order\", Resource: \"acct\", Order: []string{\"B\", \"A\"}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// fuzzSummary is the aggregated output of \"fls demo fuzz\".\ntype fuzzSummary struct {\n\tName   string `json:\"name\"`\n\tOK     bool   `json:\"ok\"`\n\tSeeds  int    `json:\"seeds\"`\n\tRuns   []fuzzRun `json:\"runs\"`\n}\n\ntype fuzzRun struct {\n\tSeed       int64 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tOK         bool  `json:\"ok\"`\n\tCommits    int   `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected   int   `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tGrants     int   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tViolations []string `json:\"violations,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// runFuzz generates lossy/duplicated/reordered workloads for several seeds.\nfunc runFuzz(seeds int) int {\n\tsummary := fuzzSummary{Name: \"fuzz\", OK: true, Seeds: seeds}\n\tfor s := int64(1); s <= int64(seeds); s++ {\n\t\tsc := buildFuzzScenario(s)\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tfr := fuzzRun{Seed: s, OK: res.OK, Commits: len(res.Commits)}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfr.Violations = append(fr.Violations, c.Kind+\": \"+c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, t := range res.Traces {\n\t\t\tswitch t.Type {\n\t\t\tcase \"resource.rejected\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Rejected++\n\t\t\tcase \"lock.granted\":\n\t\t\t\tfr.Grants++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !fr.OK {\n\t\t\tsummary.OK = false\n\t\t}\n\t\tsummary.Runs = append(summary.Runs, fr)\n\t}\n\traw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(summary, \"\", \"  \")\n\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\tif !summary.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ FAIL\")\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FUZZ PASS: %d seeds\\n\", seeds)\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. All randomness\nfunc buildFuzzScenario(s int64) *runner.Scenario {\n\tnet := sim.NetConfig{\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2,\n\t\tLossProb: 0.15, DuplicateProb: 0.08, ReorderProb: 0.08,\n\t}\n\treturn &runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    fmt.Sprintf(\"fuzz-%d\", s),\n\t\tSeed:    s,\n\t\tMaxTime: 200,\n\t\tNetwork: net,\n\t\tResources: []runner.ResourceCfg{{Name: \"acct\", NodeID: \"res-1\", Fenced: true}},\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"},\n\t\tActions: []runner.Action{\n\t\t\t{Time: 0, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 20, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 40, Type: \"acquire\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", TTL: 12},\n\t\t\t{Time: 2, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 22, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"B\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"b\"},\n\t\t\t{Time: 42, Type: \"compete\", Node: \"C\", Resource: \"acct\", Steps: 30, Every: 4, Prefix: \"c\"},\n\t\t\t// A pauses past a lease; zombie writes afterwards must all fail.\n\t\t\t{Time: 60, Type: \"pause\", Node: \"A\", Until: 90},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":224,"oldLines":7,"newStart":224,"newLines":29,"lines":["   return 0"," }"," ","+// cmdDemoJSON prints the scenario JSON (without running it) so examples/ can","+// be generated from the exact built-in definitions.","+func cmdDemoJSON(args []string) int {","+  if len(args) == 0 {","+    fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"usage: fls demo-json <name>\")","+    return 2","+  }","+  builder, ok := demos[args[0]]","+  if !ok {","+    fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"unknown demo %q\\n\", args[0])","+    return 2","+  }","+  raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(builder(1), \"\", \"  \")","+  if err != nil {","+    panic(err)","+  }","+  fmt.Println(string(raw))","+  return 0","+}","+"," // buildFuzzScenario produces a fixed-shape lossy workload. \"\\n\"))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestStaleFenceNeverAccepted is the headline acceptance property across all\n// three required fault shapes: in every successful run each resource's\n// accepted fence tokens are strictly increasing.\nfunc TestStaleFenceNeverAccepted(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, f := range []string{\"renew-lost.json\", \"pause-expired.json\", \"late-message.json\", \"fuzz.json\"} {\n\t\tt.Run(f, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tsc := mustLoad(t, filepath.Join(\"..\", \"..\", \"examples\", f))\n\t\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\t\tseen := map[string]int64{}\n\t\t\tfor _, c := range res.Commits {\n\t\t\t\tif prev, ok := seen[c.Resource]; ok && c.Fence <= prev {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"resource %s accepted fence %d after %d (node %s)\", c.Resource, c.Fence, prev, c.Node)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tseen[c.Resource] = c.Fence\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestFuzzManySeeds reruns the lossy shape over many seeds: whatever the loss,\n// duplication, reordering or pause int64(1); seed <= 25; seed++ {\n\t\tsc.Seed = seed\n\t\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\t\tseen := map[string]int64{}\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Commits {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := seen[c.Resource]; ok && c.Fence <= prev {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"seed %d: resource %s accepted fence %d after %d\", seed, c.Resource, c.Fence, prev)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tseen[c.Resource] = c.Fence\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Sanity: an empty commit log \"submit\", Node: \"A\", Resource: \"x\", Value: \"a-stale\"},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tres := runner.Run(sc)\n\tif !res.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"inline scenario should pass: %+v\", res.Checks)\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"write result:\", err)\n\t\t\treturn 2\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !quiet {\n\t\tfmt.Println(string(raw))\n\t}\n\tif !res.OK {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"FAIL: %s\\n\", res.Name)\n\t\tfor _, c := range res.Checks {\n\t\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"  - %s: %s\\n\", c.Kind, c.Detail)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"PASS: %s (%d checks)\\n\", res.Name, len(res.Checks))\n\treturn 0\n}\n\nfunc cmdRun(args []string) int {\n\tvar path, out string\n\tquiet := false\n\tfor i := 0; {"parentUuid":"c5a4d132-078c-4ecb-ae00-0668033e0b24","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"原因找到了：t=1 有条 `net.random_drop`——A 的 acquire **响应**被随机丢了（种子 1 的 RNG 序列），A 从未进入 holds，compete 第一次 tick 因 `holds==nil` 停止。这暴露两个问题：\n\n1. fuzz 场景初始 acquire 不应受随机丢包影响（否则测试空洞）；\n2. compete 在没有 hold 时应重试等待，而非静默终止。\n\n修复 compete：无 hold 时仍然继续重排几个 tick（等获取），丢锁后继续（已有）。同时 compete 循环用独立计数而非依赖 hold 存在：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_cdd623869e9941f66a29d5ee","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":651,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":110392,"output_tokens":811,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"c8f25d03-80f3-405b-aba8-414551fbafef","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:27:07.967Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/b","sessionId":"2fcf0ef6-4c36-49fb-8d4f-af07b76e7558","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-b","slug":"purrfect-wishing-llama"}
